name: farehunter
description: Finds the cheapest way to fly from anywhere, in your currency: cash fares, nearby dates, miles from 30+ airline programs (United, Aeroplan, Flying Blue, Avios, Smiles, LATAM Pass…), buying miles and transferring card points (Amex, Chase, Citi, Livelo…). Multi-language (en/pt/es). Runs on your computer with your own keys; never buys or books anything.
